terminals.name: lumen-renderer
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the Lumen (apps/chat) Electron renderer on http://localhost:5173.

terminals.name: lumen-app
terminals.description: Canonical Cursor Cloud launch for the Lumen Electron desktop app. Waits for the renderer, then runs Electron in a private D-Bus session with a dedicated auto-unlocked keyring so safeStorage works without any login-keyring password prompt. Restart this terminal to relaunch the app.
